description: Renovate opens the dependency update pull requests of infra. The shared presets of renovate/ set the schedule, the groups, the labels and the managers of k8s/. config:recommended ignores each tests/ and examples/ folder, but the tests and the examples of infra are checks that CI runs, so Renovate updates them too. Renovate ignores only the fixture tests/renovate/: its pins of infra stay at one release tag, and tests/test-renovate-presets.sh reads them.

customManagers.description: The Renovate release of tests/test-renovate-presets.sh and tests/test-repository-template.sh, which run the config validator and the extract with npx, and the release-please release whose schemas tests/test-repository-template.sh reads.

packageRules.description: Renovate publishes several releases a day, so even a patch of the npm package waits for the schedule, as the Renovate images do in the base preset.
